talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk
talents.description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all normal ranged attacks have a {1|2|3|4|5}% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Endurance Training
talents.description: Increases the Health of your pets by {3|6|9|12|15}%.

talents.name: Improved Eyes of the Beast
talents.description: Increases the duration of your Eyes of the Beast by {30|60} sec.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
talents.description: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Thick Hide
talents.description: Increases the Armor rating of your pets by {10|20|30}%.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet
talents.description: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by {3|6} sec, mana cost is reduced by {20|40}%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional {15|30}%.

talents.name: Pathfinding
talents.description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by {3|6}%.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness
talents.description: Increases the outdoor movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Unleashed Fury
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your pets by {4|8|12|16|20}%.

talents.name: Improved Mend Pet
talents.description: Gives the Mend Pet spell a {15|50}% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect from the pet each tick.

talents.name: Ferocity
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets by {3|6|9|12|15}%.

talents.name: Spirit Bond
talents.description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate {1|2}% of total health every 10 sec.

talents.name: Intimidation
talents.description: Command your pet to intimidate the target on the next successful melee attack, causing a high amount of threat and stunning the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
talents.description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by {10|20}%.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.description: Gives your pet a {20|40|60|80|100}% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath
talents.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot
talents.description: Gives your Concussive Shot a {4|8|12|16|20}% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Efficiency
talents.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots and Stings by {2|4|6|8|10}%.

talents.name: Improved Hunter's Mark
talents.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Hunter's Mark spell by {3|6|9|12|15}%.

talents.name: Lethal Shots
talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Aimed Shot
talents.description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 70.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by {0.2|0.4|0.6|0.8|1} sec.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
talents.description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by {2|4|6} yards.

talents.name: Improved Serpent Sting
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by {2|4|6|8|10}%.

talents.name: Mortal Shots
talents.description: Increases your ranged weapon critical strike damage bonus by {6|12|18|24|30}%.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
talents.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

talents.name: Barrage
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot and Volley spells by {5|10|15}%.

talents.name: Improved Scorpid Sting
talents.description: Reduces the Stamina of targets affected by your Scorpid Sting by {10|20|30}% of the amount of Strength reduced.

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura
talents.description: Increases the attack power of party members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

talents.name: Monster Slaying
talents.description: Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by {1|2|3}% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by an additional {1|2|3}%.

talents.name: Humanoid Slaying
talents.description: Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by {1|2|3}% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional {1|2|3}%.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by {1|2|3|4|5}%.

talents.name: Entrapment
talents.description: Gives your Immolation Trap, Frost Trap, and Explosive Trap a {5|10|15|20|25}% chance to entrap the target, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite by {10|20}%.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip
talents.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a {4|8|12|16|20}% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Clever Traps
talents.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by {15|30}% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by {15|30}%.

talents.name: Survivalist
talents.description: Increases total health by {2|4|6|8|10}%.

talents.name: Deterrence
talents.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Trap Mastery
talents.description: Decreases the chance enemies will resist trap effects by {5|10}%.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.description: Increases hit chance by {1|2|3}% and increases the chance movement impairing effects will be resisted by an additional {5|10|15}%.

talents.name: Improved Feign Death
talents.description: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by {2|4}%.

talents.name: Killer Instinct
talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by {1|2|3}%.

talents.name: Counterattack
talents.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 40 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.description: Increases your Agility by {3|6|9|12|15}%.

talents.name: Wyvern Sting
talents.description: A stinging shot that puts the target to sleep for 12 sec. Any damage will cancel the effect. When the target wakes up, the Sting causes 300 Nature damage over 12 sec. Only usable out of combat. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on the target at a time.
